empty.title: No widgets yet
empty.detail: Add a number, a chart, a table or some text.

widget.deleted: Widget deleted. Undo brings it back.

keyboard.moveStart: Moving. Use the arrow keys, Enter to finish, Escape to cancel.
keyboard.resizeStart: Resizing. Right and left change the width, down and up the height. Enter to finish, Escape to cancel.

keyboard.cannotMove: It cannot move further that way.

library.title: Add a widget
library.description: Choose what to show. You can change its settings next.
library.noTable: This base has no table to show.

about.kpi: One number, with the previous period or a target
about.bar: Compare groups as bars, grouped or stacked

about.pie: Each group's share of the whole

about.table: Records, or a summary by group
about.filter_control: A filter people choose a value in

panel.title: Settings: {{name}}
panel.invalid: Not saved: fix the settings marked below
panel.filterHint: Only records that match are counted. Viewers never see this filter.
panel.filterEmpty: No condition yet: every record of the table is counted.

panel.seriesHint: With series, the chart shows one metric.
panel.area: Fill the area under the line
panel.emptyText: Text when there is no data
panel.thresholdsHint: The number takes the color of the first threshold it is below.
panel.parentHint: Its choices narrow to what the other filter allows.
panel.defaultUser: Filters on people start without a default.
panel.boundWait: Available once the filter is saved.
panel.boundNone: No widget of this dashboard reads this table.

globalFilters.needTarget: Choose a field in at least one table.

filters.numberInvalid: Enter numbers, the minimum not above the maximum.
filters.moreOptions: More values match. Search to find the one you need.
filters.optionsFailed: The values could not be loaded.
filters.noPermission: You don't have permission to use this filter

filters.offOnLink: Filters are turned off for this link.
